name: What types of trim are used on mobile homes?

mainEntity.name: What types of trim are used on mobile homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobile homes commonly use various types of trim to cover seams and protect edges. This includes interior trim like baseboards, crown molding, and door/window casings, often made from wood, MDF, or vinyl. Exterior trim, such as skirting trim, fascia, and corner trim, is typically made from weather-resistant materials like aluminum, vinyl, or sometimes fiber cement. The specific type depends on the manufacturer, the age of the home, and whether it's an interior or exterior application.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mobile homes use interior trim like baseboards and casings (wood, MDF, vinyl) and exterior trim like skirting and fascia (aluminum, vinyl). Materials vary by location and home age.
